notes.title: BULLETGROUNDS Patch Notes - 4th of January, 2019
notes.notes:
Hello keyboard warriors,

We're happy to start 2019 with new content update and hope you guys will love all new cool stuff! 

Time to oil your weapons, count your ammo and grab those medkits, because another test session is just around the corner.

User interface improvements

 Added New loadout icons
 Added Killfeed text colors
 Added Weapon icons to killfeed
 Added New Font for UI
 Added New vehicles to spawn screen
 Added Tooltips ingame
 Added Weapon statistics


Gameplay improvements

MAP

 Added New map Woke Island
 Added Day & Night cycle
 Added Weather patterns


VEHICLES & PLANES

 Added Jeep
 Added Halftrack
 Added Light tank
 Added Heavy tank
 Added Bomber plane
 Added Fighter/Bomber plane


WEAPONS

 Flame thrower
 Range increased
 Mortar reworked
 New camera angle
 Mortar projectile control in mid flight (WASD)
 Bazooka 
 Range increased
 Damage reduced
 Panzerfaust
 Range decreased
 Damage increased

notes.title: 15th of December Patch notes
notes.notes:
Fixes
 Jumping in the air while falling is no longer possible.
 Dying while using mortar will correctly put you in spawn menu.
 Tanks now always play shoot animation and projectile explosion.


Tweaks
 G43 and Garand headshot damage increased significantly.
 Plane maneuverability adjusted.
 Buildables have decay.

notes.title: End of November update logs
notes.notes:
Hello community
Another month gone by with a few test sessions on the front lines.
Tomorrow it's time to shave off your Movembers and prepare for some serious combat action, so look sharp and drive fear into your enemies hearts!


Below is the changelog for next test session:
Plane
-Steering completely controlled with mouse and camera angle changes on sharp turns, giving you a better perspective what is going around your plane.
Suggested by community member: kraken_07_ AKA POUTINE

Tanks
-Camera stabilizer (crosshair wont be bouncing on every bump)
-Hitbox added for turret collision (was missing)

Infantry
-Life regeneration kicks in after 15 seconds of not taking any damage and heals player for 10hp/second. 
-Helmets will block % of damage instead of negate full damage on hit.
-Added sound to helmet impacts
-Added camera shoulder switching (default key: Caps lock)
-Added minor camera shake to walking
-Adjusted camera height for better usage in buildings and bunkers
-Adjusted camera distance, now closer to character
-Characters have close quarters animation to aiming if your target is next to you

Weapons & kits
-Sniper head shots now kill instantly
-removed "autofire" mechanic from semiautos (previously could hold down mouse1 to autofire)
-Ammobox, medkit and mines are now dropped instantly on equip
-Added proper pistol for germans
-Fixed bazooka hitting player on shoot
-Flamethrower tweaked

Buildables
-New sandbag model providing better cover
-Barbed wire fence, spawn 5 at a time
-Tank traps spawnd in clusters of 3
-Bunkers disabled for redesign

Game mode
-Pushit has a victory condition
-Map restart when game ends
-Scoreboards have proper player names (used to have pc names)
-Building walls take damage from other than explosive sources
-Score are now grouped by type, rather than all scores being independent (damage numbers shouldn't flood your screen)
-Added new score types

Hello BULLETGROUNDS community!

We're hard at work with the game to ensure a smooth gameplay somewhere around december.
Here is a list of major issues that we have patched up all thanks to our testers.

If u're interested in testing, contact Igor on our official discord channel!
https://discord.gg/ATC7D6C

Performance improvements

 LOD updates for performance
 Particle effects caused performance issues
 network replication improvements


Vehicles

 Leaving vehicles made player fall through ground sometimes (fixed)
 Plane wing collision fixed


Infantry

 Flamethrower bugs fixed
 Mortar usage fixes (sometimes players using mortars didn't die while using it)
 Prone mechanic only usable while machine gun is equipped
 Germans now use proper SMG


Quality of life and misc.

 respawn timer added on death
 Added more keybind options
 missing weapon icons added
 Added hit indicators for infantry, tanks and planes (easier to see where u're being shot from)
